scope: Two exposed development datasets; fixed seed-loss means, not ensembles or independent confirmation

robin.reason: Both STAGED_P seeds select step0 for the basic policy and alpha0 for the auxiliary policy, exactly returning the trained LEVEL parent. RAW basic/alpha mean TEST MSE is slightly worse than the parent, with intervals including zero. No useful nonzero staged candidate remains here; repeating Robin cost would not establish new P efficacy.

jena.reason: Both STAGED_P seeds select trained heads and alpha1. Combined MSE 0.2798835818109315 improves over parent 0.3243591575923674 and matched RAW 0.28628498787868406. This supports a conditional incremental-adaptation candidate worth measuring on Jena, while v8 JOINT_PQ 0.27971447774246144, DIRECT 0.27398416828202665 and LoRA 0.24058989518638096 prevent an accuracy-superiority/default-replacement claim. Cost will determine the remaining practical tradeoff, not justify a post-TEST model change.

decision.interpretation: This is the preapproved conditional measurement decision. It does not select a new model, alpha, channel or dataset routing rule. Both exposed development evaluations remain reported.
decision.grid: Protocol maximum17 role/seed instances; exact-function aliases only; B1/B4 plus uncompressed B4 M24; three order blocks and F0 sentinels. No cross-dataset or old/new timing ratio.
